segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: What if she has a ceramic knife
segments.translation: 那拐杖里说不定藏了个

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: in there that can go through the metal detector?
segments.translation: 金属探测器查不出来的陶瓷刀呢

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: And yet you waste your time harassing a little kid.
segments.translation: 你却在这里把时间浪费在骚扰小孩子上

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Ma'am, you seem to know an awful lot about
segments.translation: 女士 你似乎非常了解

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: sneaking contraband on to a plane.
segments.translation: 如何偷带违禁品上飞机啊

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Yeah, I'm Colombian.
segments.translation: 是啊 姐可是哥伦比亚人

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Have you ever been to Japan?
segments.translation: 那你有没有去过日本呢

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: I would like to make a phone call.
segments.translation: 我想先打一通电话

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Ladies and gentlemen, preboarding for our flight to Maui...
segments.translation: 女士们先生们 飞往茂伊岛的航班

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: will begin in the next few minutes.
segments.translation: 马上开始办理登机

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: - Luke, please stop spinning. - Sorry.
segments.translation: -卢克 快别转了 -对不起

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Now make the airport stop spinning.
segments.translation: 能不能让机场也别再转了

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: We made it! Claire!
segments.translation: 我们做到啦 克莱尔

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Oh, my God. Thank God you're here.
segments.translation: 谢天谢地 你终于来了

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: Oh, honey!
segments.translation: 亲爱的

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: - I am so sorry. - It was my fault.
segments.translation: -真是对不起 -都是我不好

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: - It wasn't your fault. - I should have known what you wanted.
segments.translation: -不是你的错 -我应该想到你要什么的

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: - Are you drunk? - Kinda.
segments.translation: -你是不是喝高了 -有点吧

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: And once I spent a week in Cancún,
segments.translation: 有次我去墨西哥的坎昆玩了一周

segments.sceneTitle: 你之前在日本从事什么活动
segments.text: which, by the way, did not live up to the hype.
segments.translation: 要我说 远远没有传说得那么好玩

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Can somebody tell me what the hell is going on?
segments.translation: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: We're almost done here, sir.
segments.translation: 我们就快问完了 先生

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - So you and your son are traveling together? - Yes.
segments.translation: -你和你的儿子计划一同旅行是吗 -是的

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Then why are you departing Maui on different dates?
segments.translation: 那为什么你们离开茂伊岛的时间不同

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Well, because he's traveling back home with his family.
segments.translation: 因为他要和一大家子先回来

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - What? - Surprise!
segments.translation: -什么 -惊喜

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: They're only staying for six days.
segments.translation: 他们只在那呆6天

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - The rest of the time it's only you and me. - Really?
segments.translation: -剩下来的时间只属于我们俩 -真的吗

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Mm-hmm. I wanted to spend some time alone with my husband-
segments.translation: 嗯呀 我就想跟我老公单独待一会儿

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: drink cocktails by the pool, sleep in.
segments.translation: 在泳池边上喝点鸡尾酒啊 睡睡懒觉

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: I could not love you any more than I do right now.
segments.translation: 我现在已经爱你到无以复加了

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: I also found a topless beach.
segments.translation: 我还找到了一个裸体沙滩

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: I was wrong.
segments.translation: 那我只能更爱你了

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Mr. Jackson, have a great flight.
segments.translation: 杰克逊先生 旅途愉快

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: It's to the left. Oh, gorgeous!
segments.translation: 请走左边 真漂亮

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - Oh, thank you. It's vintage. - Think he meant Lily.
segments.translation: -谢谢 是复古衫 -他是在说莉莉吧

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: You don't know that.
segments.translation: 你又说不准

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Hey, there's another hottie for you at 5:00.
segments.translation: 五点钟方向有个适合你的帅哥哦

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: I think he's an artist.
segments.translation: 他想必应该是个艺术家

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: It's whale "Watching."
segments.translation: 是"观赏"鲸鱼

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - Whale washing. - Watching.
segments.translation: -"浣赏"鲸鱼 -"观赏"

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - Washing. - That's close enough.
segments.translation: -"浣赏" -差不多了

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Have a good flight, sir.
segments.translation: 旅途愉快 先生

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: Quick, do your zombie impression.
segments.translation: 快 扮个僵尸给人看看

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: - She hasn't been drinking, has she? - Oh, no, no, no.
segments.translation: -她不是喝醉了吧 -没有没有

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: She's- She's hilarious. Okay, let's do bride of Frankenstein.
segments.translation: 她在搞笑呢 再来一个"僵尸抱"

segments.sceneTitle: 来个人跟我解释一下这是怎么回事
segments.text: It's so, so good.
segments.translation: 真是太 太逼真了
